coverage_notes: validateReplayTrace checks shape/version and selected checkpoint invariants; it does not prove command legality, RNG alignment, or mechanical replay equivalence (src/data/elite-redux/replay-trace.ts#L268-L315).
makeReplayTrace emits fields in version, seed, gameModeId, difficulty, challenges, roster, events, then optional coop/endState/checkpoint order (src/data/elite-redux/replay-trace.ts#L338-L364).

The recorder is host-only for co-op, keeps a ten-wave ring/window, and chooses a wave-window checkpoint; older events/checkpoints are intentionally discarded (src/data/elite-redux/replay-recorder.ts#L24-L28, src/data/elite-redux/replay-recorder.ts#L53-L96, src/data/elite-redux/replay-recorder.ts#L162-L181).

canonical_vs_presentation.rule: A Phaser handle may be rebuilt from canonical state; it is not evidence for canonical mechanical truth. The apply path nevertheless calls presentation helpers, so the future kernel must expose an adapter boundary.

normalization: Checkpoint mon HP is clamped to [0,maxHp], maxHp is at least 1, status stages are exactly seven values clamped to [-6,6], and hp=0 forces fainted=true (src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-battle-checkpoint.ts#L148-L210).

Checkpoint arena tags clamp turnCount to >=0 and layers to >=1; tags are sorted by tagType/side in the engine reader (src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-battle-checkpoint.ts#L88-L95, src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-battle-engine.ts#L321-L343).
Guest admission rejects stale ticks; legacy undefined ticks are accepted without advancing the monotonic counter (src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-battle-engine.ts#L345-L396).

Weather/terrain duration counters are applied for presentation/state repair but are deliberately excluded from checksum canonical truth because of legitimate one-tick skew (src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-battle-engine.ts#L1002-L1225, src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-replication-contract.ts#L73-L118).

nondeterministic_boundaries.impact: ReplayTrace has no random-call cursor; seed-only mid-run replay cannot establish mechanical truth.
Excluded from digest and not a kernel mechanic.
Timer expiry/retry is runtime ordering, not replay mechanical state.
Counters are force-set/applied but excluded from checksum because legitimate one-tick skew exists.
Counters are optional/additive and absent on old payloads; absent means legacy no-substate behavior, not proven zero in all callers.
Completion timing and handles do not belong to canonical mechanical state.
Ticks provide stale-state admission, but ReplayTrace has no delivery/channel frontier.
Per-client ids and encounter/granted-mon identity can diverge; the source has normalization but no Rust identity contract yet.

producers.owner: host recorder in co-op; single-player recorder otherwise

producers.timer_owner: save invocation; playTime/timestamp use wall clock

consumers.timer_owner: host owns mechanic timers; guest applies received values

canonicalization.json_order: This file and all inventory arrays use source declaration/order or explicit stable order. ReplayTrace construction order is fixed by makeReplayTrace; digest canonicalization sorts object keys but preserves array order.

replay_trace.rule: No replay checksum is defined here. Events remain ordered input; optional fields stay absent when the producer does not provide them.

checkpoint.rule: Normalize numeric bounds before wire emission; preserve optional omission; arena tags are keyed by tagType/side and durations/layers are applied but not checksum truth.

authoritative_state.rule: Use host-authored party JSON and id/seat keyed field material; apply topology before scalar fields; waveSeed is a cursor carrier and tick is an admission field, not checksum material.

checksum.rule: Canonical object keys sort lexicographically; arrays retain semantic order; null and finite numbers normalize; -0 becomes 0; integers use integer text; other numbers use precision 12; FNV-1a64 hashes UTF-16 code units.

save_data_digest.rule: Normalize SessionSaveData by explicit denylist, modifier/id/map/relic normalization, canonicalize sorted-key JSON, then FNV-1a64. Read failure returns sentinel.

sentinel.meaning: digest capture/read failure; consumers must not treat it as proof of equal mechanical state

rules: A field may be transported and applied without being checksum truth; the replication contract is authoritative for that distinction (src/data/elite-redux/coop/coop-replication-contract.ts#L73-L268).
A field with an optional declaration is not silently equivalent to null, zero, or empty; presence must survive the Rust codec until the source ambiguity is resolved.
Phaser/browser handles, animation completion, and UI refresh are adapter outputs. They cannot be used to resolve the stop-condition question of canonical mechanical truth.
Current producer/consumer ownership is a migration map. It does not freeze a new public wire contract.
